name: New Caledonia
summary_text: New Caledonia: full French law applies; customary-authority areas socially conservative; Nouméa tolerant. Scored as a dependent jurisdiction: the parent framework governs what a visitor encounters, plus local society and enforcement. Score re-anchored 2026-09-24: France (0.67) plus a local delta of -0.02. This jurisdiction was not covered by the dedicated state/province research passes.

sources.title: The Plight Of Trans Women In Prison
sources.claim_summary: BuzzFeed News feature (Jan 2018, French context): trans women in France incarcerated on the basis of their legal gender fall into a legal gray area - relevant to New Caledonia as a French territory applying French law.

CGLPL opinion of 25 May 2021 on the treatment of transgender persons in places of deprivation of liberty (French context, applicable in New Caledonia): serious violations persist across places of detention.

sources.title: » L’«identité sexuelle» devient un motif de discrimination dans le code pénal
sources.claim_summary: Yagg (July 2012, in French): 'sexual identity' became a discrimination ground in the French Penal Code (Article L225-1) via the sexual-harassment law - enabling prosecution of transphobia as discrimination; French law applies in New Caledonia.
